RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-woman panel is not evidence of anything on its own. Mixed and single-sex panels occur routinely by chance, especially in planning and HR, where women are well represented. Raising it without more would read as sour grapes and would likely damage your standing locally — a serious cost in a field where reputation travels.

The real anomaly is the two-week silence and the credential gap. Chase the written rationale in writing, citing any applicable policy or records legislation. "Extensive public consultation experience" may genuinely have been the council's priority, perhaps after a contentious project.

If the rationale arrives thin, inconsistent, or never, reassess then — with substance, not panel composition.
